investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stoneline Journeys (travel booking); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1 (zones europe-west1-b/europe-west1-c/europe-west1-d); network range 10.190.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster stonel-prod-europe (GKE); reservations-api pods run with 8 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
